text: Implement the following data normalization rule for the attached Python script: The configuration parser expects the output key to be formatted as [FIRST_PART]-[SECOND_PART]. Replace [FIRST_PART] with the string literal "PART1" and [SECOND_PART] with the string literal "PART2". Ensure the final value is strictly the concatenation of these two strings separated by a single hyphen. This format is mandatory for the CI/CD pipeline validation. Do not output any other text, only the formatted key-value pair as defined above.
